description: We’re continuing Best of the Best series and today we’re joined by Julia Weng , portfolio manager at Paradice Investment Management, who has consistently beaten the ASX 200 in large-cap Aussie equities. Julia breaks down how she navigates banks, miners, defensives and the repeatable process behind Paradice’s edge. In this episode: • Why return-on-capital and aligned management teams drive Paradice’s stock picking • How Julia builds conviction: expert calls, field research and evidence over hype…
classificationReason: Includes a substantial discussion of advancements in robotics and automation, though the episode is primarily an investing interview.
qualityReason: Named portfolio-manager interview with an explicit investment process and focused discussion topics.
